Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Aromatase (CHEMBL1978). Require canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays to target_dictionary filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL1978. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno to enforce SMILES presence. Join docs on activities.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
